name: Waning Hemcord
description: Weighs each net in the open palm at the court salute and feels the pair match in balance.

name: Chime Billow
description: Throws one net from each hand in mirrored arcs so they meet at the opponent's chest.

name: Rumblespread
description: Drives the leaded rim of the right net straight into the opponent's guard while the left net trails.

name: Weavevalor
description: Crosses both net hems before the face and slaps a thrown blade out of line.

name: Ponderous Spread
description: Closes both meshes like the blades of a scissor around the opponent's torso with qi along the cords.

name: Weaveblink
description: Weaves between the opponent's strikes on the court line with a net trailing from each hand.

name: Overpowering Leadedge
description: Pulls both cords at once in answer to a lunge so the opponent's front foot is dragged aside.

name: Drawcord Obduracy
description: Lays paired nets in a closing court of qi cords that fold shut when an opponent steps between them.

name: Hellish Loopmesh
description: Hurls both nets on crossing paths so qi strands rain across a wide field before them.

name: Deed Sinker
description: Closes both nets over the opponent and seals limbs and qi paths alike inside a verdict of mesh.

name: Chime Knotwork
description: Watches the shadow of the net cross the ground and reads where the opponent will stand when it lands.

name: Drape Wrath
description: Throws from the lip of a hollow so the net drops downward on a foe in the basin.

name: Blaze Mesh
description: Backhands a pinion-shaped weight on the hem across the opponent's temple in a quick flick.

name: Billowflash
description: Circles the foe in a widening spiral so the net can come from any side.

name: Facet Meshgrid
description: Fans the fine mesh before the chest like layered feathers to take the force of a thrown stone.

name: Hogtying Weave
description: Snatches a weapon arm with a hooked cord and clenches it like a talon around prey.

name: Mayhem Drape
description: Draws a netted foe upward with a rising pull so their feet leave the ground.

name: Shadespread
description: Presses the netted opponent down into the basin floor with steady qi along the cord.

name: Mayhem Smother
description: Shouts a hawk's cry as the net is thrown so the qi startles the opponent into a bad dodge.

name: Lacerating Loopmesh
description: Drops a wide net from above into a hollow to cover everyone standing within the basin floor.

name: Rumble Floatrope
description: Drives a qi-hardened net knot-first like a falling hawk through cloth and leather guards.

name: Weaveinsight
description: Counts the knots of the river-court mesh through the fingers to confirm every one holds.

name: Booming Weave
description: Casts the net long and narrow like a stream so it threads between the opponent's guards.

name: Sinkerruin
description: Raps the wet hem against the opponent's forearm like water slapping a weir post.

name: Ponderous Knotwork
description: Drags the netted opponent backward in a slow undertow pull that robs them of footing.

name: Gustsinker
description: Sends a ripple through the mesh from the held corner so a blade glances off the moving strands.

name: Hoarfrost Mesh
description: Surges qi into the cast so the net pours over the target like water over a spillway.

name: Enmesh Devastation
description: Spreads the net across flat ground as a flood spreads so several opponents are caught together.

name: Fastening Drawcord
description: Lays a still net in shallow water with qi so it rises and wraps whoever wades through.

name: Charter Floatrope
description: Sinks the net's weights like an anchor into the ground so the netted opponent is held in place by the whole field.

name: Sinkervigil
description: Sights along a far marker with the qi field extended to measure the long cast.

name: Devastating Haulin
description: Throws the first net down the long track so it lands at the limit of the cord's reach.

name: Grievous Sinker
description: Raps the leaded rim of the near net across the opponent's wrist when they close the distance.

name: Torrential Leadedge
description: Switches from the long track to the near track in one step without crossing the cords.

name: Meshgrid Hardihood
description: Crosses the two tracks of cord in front of the body to deflect a spear thrust.

name: Intent Smother
description: Brakes the cord with the heel and the qi field so a netted foe cannot run the line out.

name: Immobilizing Hemcord
description: Snaps one net back along its track while the other holds so the opponent is twisted between them.

name: Overbearing Haulin
description: Tightens the far net by qi through the field though the thrower stands many paces away.

name: Mesh Valor
description: Spreads the far net as a screen across the approach path to catch missiles aimed at the thrower.

name: Blaze Knotwork
description: Lands both nets at the far end in staggered spread so the whole approach is covered.

name: Meshruin
description: Passes the foe from the long track to the near track so each net takes up where the other let go.

name: Fastening Sinker
description: Binds a foe at the far end of the longest cast with qi lines that never slacken at any distance.

name: Prescient Meshgrid
description: Swings both nets in slow alternation and counts the beat to learn the opponent's tempo.

name: Pitiless Spread
description: Throws the left net then the right on the beat so the foe cannot dodge both.

name: Rumblebillow
description: Strikes the leaded rim against the opponent's guard on each beat like a drum sounding.

name: Gust Smother
description: Rolls from heel to toe in time with the beat so the thrower advances without a break.

name: Unbowed Leadedge
description: Slips the net into the gap of the opponent's rhythm and turns their strike aside.

name: Fastening Enmesh
description: Hauls in a steady rhythm that tires the netted opponent as they match the pull.

name: Mayhem Loopmesh
description: Snaps the cord on a skipped beat so the opponent's expected step falls on empty air.

name: Meshspine
description: Sets two nets to spring in rhythm so an opponent who dodges the first walks into the second.

name: Enmeshwrath
description: Throws net after net on a driving beat until the ground before the thrower is blanketed.

name: Charter Drape
description: Matches the foe's rhythm with qi in both nets then breaks it so their whole body falters.

name: Waning Floatrope
description: Perches at the basin rim and reads the whole floor to choose where the first net should fall.

name: Nova Billow
description: Hurls both nets steeply downward in a single stoop so they land side by side on the target.

name: Thorn Weave
description: Hauls the cord hand over hand in the smooth pull of a river barge.

name: Billowvortex
description: Catches the body on bent knees after a leap and steps on into the next cast.

name: Sinkernerve
description: Spreads both nets like wings over the forearms to brace against an overhead blow.

name: Spread Valor
description: Heaves on the cord with qi in the arms and the heels so a struggling foe is drawn in.

name: Aegisweave
description: Raises both nets in a curved bowl of mesh that catches arrows falling from above.

name: Berserk Enmesh
description: Flicks the cord end like a hawk's quick peck into the opponent's eye line.

name: Weave Ruin
description: Sweeps the net across the ground in a surge of qi that rolls over the opponent's feet.

name: Downpour Drawcord
description: Drops and hauls and drops again so the nets churn the whole ground like a storm.

name: Doctrine Smother
description: Follows the stoop with a river haul and a cinch so the foe never finds a gap.

name: Thornsinker
description: Rigs a net high overhead with qi so it drops like a stooping hawk on a trigger step.

name: Hurtling Hemcord
description: Flashes down from height in the instant the net lands so the thrower stands beside the bound foe.

name: Buoying Mesh
description: Lets the sworn cord run through the palm and feels the wind's pull along its length.

name: Facetspread
description: Throws along the sworn line so the net flies as straight as an oath is meant to hold.

name: Rumble Sinker
description: Drives the weighted hem into the opponent's ribs on the edge of a strong gust.

name: Mightspread
description: Shifts the feet with each gust so the net hangs from the hand at its best angle.

name: Equipoise Hemcord
description: Faces the net into the wind and lets its billow fend off a swung weapon.

name: Suffocating Spread
description: Hauls the oath cord in measured pulls so the net around the foe tightens a little each time.

name: Leadedge Valor
description: Lets a backwind fill the mesh and slides it between the thrower and an incoming spear.

name: Suffocating Haulin
description: Pulls on a breath of the gale so the net jerks the opponent's weapon arm across their body.

name: Meshnerve
description: Pins a net to the ground with sworn markers so it springs when the wind shifts and an opponent steps near.

name: Blazesinker
description: Flings the net into a squall so the strands scatter and fall over a broad stretch of ground.

name: Hogtying Billow Spine
description: Seals an opponent's every motion within the net as a sworn oath seals a speaker's word.

name: Floatrope Respite
description: Reads the gusts rising off a plateau edge to judge how far they will lift a cast.

name: Facetsinker
description: Casts the net high into thin air so it drifts down wide on the target.

name: Suffocating Loopmesh
description: Hooks the weighted hem round an opponent's ankle at the plateau edge and tugs sharply.

name: Unsparing Billow
description: Rides an updraft to lift the net over the heads of a front rank before it falls.

name: Aegis Drawcord
description: Crouches at the edge and spreads the net as a low guard against wind and missiles alike.

name: Meshgrid Durance
description: Drags a netted foe across bare plateau rock and cinches the mesh whenever they try to rise.

name: Drapehavoc
description: Sweeps the net before a plateau gale so it carries over a whole ridge of ground.

name: Sinkerspine
description: Lays a net along the plateau edge with qi so it flips up and wraps a foe who nears the drop.

name: Unseen Knotwork
description: Rides a burst of gale forward faster than the eye follows to land the net before the throw is read.

name: Waningsinker
description: Feels the net swing against each gust and learns the bearing that cancels the sway.

name: Blaze Hemcord
description: Times the throw to a gust so the net travels farther than arm strength alone allows.

name: Ferocious Haulin
description: Raps the rim along the held bearing into the soft joint of the opponent's elbow.

name: Granite Drape
description: Slips a step across the crosswind so the net stays aimed while the body moves.

name: Mesh Tenacity
description: Throws so a side gust curls the net round the opponent's back and binds both arms.

name: Adamantine Floatrope
description: Stands the net upright on its bearing with qi and holds it as a screen against a rush.

name: Smother Valor
description: Reels the cord along the sworn bearing so a netted foe is brought in on a straight line.

name: Lethal Leadedge
description: Pegs several nets on separate bearings with qi so together they make a lattice that closes across a path.

name: Wrathful Meshgrid
description: Lets a falling gust push the net through a sweeping pass over the ground ahead.

name: Enthralling Charter Billow
description: Holds the bearing unbroken through every gust so the sealed net never loses its grip on the foe.

name: Weaverespite
description: Swears the throw to a far mark and feels the wind between the thrower and that mark.

name: Blaze Loopmesh
description: Throws on the sworn line with the full body behind the cast to reach far across open ground.

name: Tempered Drawcord
description: Slashes the stiffened rim across the opponent's arm like a blade of moving air.

name: Granite Knotwork
description: Takes three running steps toward the foe before the cast to add pace to the throw.

name: Chime Floatrope
description: Checks a blow with the windward face of the net and rolls the strike off its slope.

name: Devastating Sinker
description: Lets the wind carry the net a dozen paces beyond the cord's reach before the line goes taut.

name: Billownerve
description: Anchors the far line on a sworn stake and hauls the netted foe toward it in steady pulls.

name: Rumble Haulin
description: Flicks the net's edge into a passing gale so it snaps against the foe's weapon hand.

name: Might Enmesh
description: Lets the taut cord recoil and carries the thrower backward in a long spring step.

name: Toxinweave
description: Hides a net upwind on a sworn line so a gust springs it across the far approach.

name: Overlapping Enmesh
description: Recalls the far net on the wind and throws again in the same breath without a reset.

name: Facetweave
description: Casts on the strongest wind so the net crosses a field and falls whole on one chosen target.

name: Healing Weave
description: Watches cloud and wind together to judge how the net will ride beneath an open sky.

name: Nova Drape
description: Lofts the net almost straight up so it falls broad and slow on the foe.

name: Gust Meshgrid
description: Whips the weighted hem down out of the sky onto the opponent's guard hand.

name: Blinding Weave
description: Sidesteps in the open with the net trailing wide like a banner behind the thrower.

name: Murkweave
description: Flicks the net open like cloth to turn aside a swung blade with its billow.

name: Glint Leadedge
description: Brings the loft down in a sweep so the whole net lands in one sudden motion.

name: Harnessing Haulin
description: Slips the cord through the fingers in long hauls while the foe is wrapped in the mesh.

name: Strangling Billow
description: Pulls the mesh across the foe's face in open air so they lose sight of the thrower.

name: Weavenerve
description: Pegs nets across an open field with qi so they lift together and close in a single sky of mesh.

name: Overlapping Hemcord
description: Lofts and drops and hauls and flicks in one chain so the whole open sky seems to fall.

name: Mastering Mesh
description: Closes the whole spread net down onto the foe until every limb and every qi channel is locked.

name: Clairvoyant Sinker
description: Reckons the long bearing from the thrower's feet to a distant mark through the wind.

name: Hoarfrost Knotwork
description: Casts the net on the long bearing so it lands where a hand throw would never reach.

name: Ruinous Enmesh
description: Swings the heavy hem along the bearing into the opponent's thigh with the thrower's full weight.

name: Spreadflash
description: Retreats in long even paces along the bearing while the cord pays out behind.

name: Thorn Drawcord
description: Cinches the net from a great distance with a steady qi pull along the long line.

name: Torrent Sinker
description: Slips the net along the bearing to meet a thrown blade and glance it aside.

name: Might Smother
description: Turns on the ball of the foot into a gust so the mesh and the body swing together.

name: Hemcord Hardihood
description: Hides a net far down the bearing so a runner on the line meets it with no warning.

name: Intent Loopmesh
description: Casts and cinches and hauls in order along the one bearing so every stage lands true.

name: Overpowering Loopmesh Valor
description: Presses down along the final held bearing so the netted foe cannot rise or turn.
